hook: BRAZIL'S RIVER FILLS A FIFTH OF OCEANS
yt_title: How Big Is The Amazon River? Brazil's Giant #Shorts
desc: The Amazon River in Brazil moves roughly two hundred thousand cubic metres of water every second. That is about a fifth of all river water entering the oceans. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Brazil's Amazon is unreal! 🌎 Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a Brazilian friend! Comment AMAZON

lines.text: How much water does the Amazon River carry? Almost unbelievable.
Roughly two hundred thousand cubic metres flow out every second.
That is about one fifth of all river water reaching the sea.
The river mouth is so wide it looks like a sea.
Its fresh water flows far into the Atlantic Ocean. How big do you think it is?

v.t: FRESH WATER FAR OUT TO SEA
